name: Adabana ni Tsukiakari
source:
Mirei Amatsu is an ordinary university student. She's enjoying the uni life with her childhood friend, Rio Kahara, until she meets Touya Hanashiki, a guy way out of her league, at a welcome party for new students. They start sleeping with each other, but one day, Rio learns of their relationship...

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/girls/work/=/product_id/RJ394003.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
天松美玲是一名普通的大学生。她和儿时的朋友河原里约一起享受大学生活，直到她在新生欢迎会上遇到了花敷冬也，一个与她格格不入的男人。他们开始互相睡觉，但有一天，里约得知了他们的关系……
